method: One independent evaluator received only the revised skill, supporting references, and seven raw requests. Expected outputs and prior review conclusions were withheld. The parent reviewed the responses against the criteria and checked exact preservation and punctuation programmatically.
model: Inherited session model; exact model identifier and inference settings were not exposed.
limitations: Seven requests were evaluated in one isolated evaluator context, not seven separate sessions.
One response per case; no baseline comparison, independent judge, or automatic discovery test.
Only cases 4 through 10 were run in this forward-test.
